items.text: 49ers WR De’Zhaun Stribling had ankle surgery, will miss close to 10 weeks (late Nov/early Dec).
items.why: Opted for repair of deltoid rupture
items.implication: Sustained opportunity for Deebo Samuel and others

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.why: Self-reported tightness post-W1, mental reps only
items.implication: Monitor practice Thurs/Fri; Chase/Higgins stable if plays

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans for IR. Drew Lock to start.
items.why: Ruled out Wednesday; short-term
items.implication: Lock starts; impacts SEA pass catchers short-term

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday; early negative sign.
items.why: Harbaugh confirmed no practice
items.implication: Questionable for Week 2; opens door for Tre Harris etc.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top Week 2 waiver wire target after strong Week 1 usage and with De'Zhaun Stribling out long-term.
items.why: 21%+ target share, RZ work in W1; Stribling surgery ~10 weeks opens role
items.implication: WR3/flex with upside in Shanahan offense

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Limited Wednesday
items.implication: Monitor; could affect target share vs CIN

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in practice; indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full participant Wednesday
items.implication: Could reclaim role; impacts Stevenson/others

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Missed Wednesday practice
items.implication: Threatens Week 2 role; monitor for JK Dobbins or others

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Surgery to quicken recovery
items.implication: Bateman/Moore elevated short-term

items.text: Travis Hunter played only specialized package snaps in W1 (jet, screens, decoy); did not pass LOS on a route. Jags clear intention for limited offensive role this season given Meyers extension and other moves.
items.why: Extremely limited specialized usage matching offseason signals
items.implication: Low fantasy floor/ceiling early; long season but not primary WR

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share); finished 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated opportunities and routes/targets in debut
items.implication: RB1 lock with massive volume
items.opportunity: 29/32 opps, high route/target share, GL potential

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after torn MCL surgery.
items.why: Torn MCL requires surgery
items.implication: Kittle primary; depth TE changes

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game.
items.why: High xFP from targets/locations but poor conversion
items.implication: Buy-low candidate; opportunity was there

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 in W1); only 2 targets 7% share but ran 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: Routes present but low volume/aDOT
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor target share ROS

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury. Hamstring issues historically linger for him and require monitoring Thursday practice for Week 2 status vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted on Wednesday injury report; Schefter report.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential miss or limited snaps opens targets for other HOU WRs.
items.opportunity: If OUT, increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury following MNF. Status for Week 2 vs JAX uncertain as hamstrings can linger.
items.why: Hamstring after MNF; Schefter confirmed DNP.
items.implication: Potential reduced role or absence boosts DEN RB committee mates.
items.opportunity: If OUT/limited, more carries for other Broncos RBs like J.K. Dobbins.

items.text: 49ers WR De’Zhaun Stribling (ankle deltoid) opted for surgery; expected miss ~10 weeks / late Nov-early Dec. Placed on IR. Deebo Samuel led slot routes Week 1 and stands to see uptick.
items.why: Surgery decision for complete recovery; Rapoport/Schefter/Shanahan.
items.implication: Sustained opportunity for Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson in SF WR room.
items.opportunity: Deebo snap/route/target share increase as primary beneficiary.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out minimum four games to quicken recovery.
items.why: Wrist surgery confirmed; Rapoport report.
items.implication: BAL WR depth thinned especially with Flowers also dinged; more work for Bateman/others.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Ravens WRs and TE Mark Andrews.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring, aggravated Week 1) DNP Wednesday practice; day-to-day per coach. Uncertain for Week 2 vs Saints; backups like Bateman/Andrews would benefit if out.
items.why: Hamstring aggravation; not spotted/participated Wednesday.
items.implication: High risk of miss or limited; have backups ready.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more volume for Mark Andrews and other BAL WRs (Lane already IR).

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice participation signals return readiness.
items.implication: Potential RB role expansion or committee shift in NE if active.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps if cleared; handcuff value rises.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP/limited Wednesday but got mental reps and explicitly expects to play Sunday vs Texans. Called sit precaution 'ridiculous'.
items.why: Back tightness post-Week 1 hit; self-reported expects play, corroborated by Schefter.
items.implication: CIN offense on track; no major downgrade yet.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week on FF Happy Hour amid SF WR injuries (Stribling IR).
items.why: Stribling long-term out; Deebo already led slot routes Week 1, uptick expected.
items.implication: Add in most leagues; startable FLEX/WR3 upside with expanded role.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps, routes, targets in SF offense.

items.text: ETR Week 2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De’Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel/Demarcus Robinson; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Plus streaming options and FAAB guidance.

items.opportunity: Immediate snap/target/carry shares for listed beneficiaries.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) DNP Wednesday but has legit chance return Week 2 or 3 per reports/coach day-to-day. Same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise—scary history. Michael Mayer fills in.
items.why: Meniscus trim ~1 week ago; Levitan notes return chance but knee history risk. Coach hopes practice later week.
items.implication: Hold; Mayer TE2 streamer if Bowers sits again. Caution on early return.
items.opportunity: Mayer exclusive TE snaps/routes if Bowers inactive.

items.why: Dominated opportunities, routes, targets as expected move to KC.
items.implication: Elite RB1 ROS usage; start every week with confidence.
items.opportunity: High snap share, goal-line, third-down, routes/targets sustained.
